operative_clauses.original_operative_text: 1-101. There is established a Small Business Conference Commission. The Commission shall be composed of five members.

original_source.page_or_item: American Presidency Project web page (transcription; not an official edition); APP node 244791; common-crawl capture 2025-01-19T01:14:57Z; Sec. 1-101

operative_clauses.original_operative_text: 1-102. The members of the Commission shall be appointed by the President. The President shall designate a Chairman from among the members.

original_source.page_or_item: American Presidency Project web page (transcription; not an official edition); APP node 244791; common-crawl capture 2025-01-19T01:14:57Z; Sec. 1-102

operative_clauses.original_operative_text: 1-201. The Commission shall recommend appropriate alternate dates for holding a White House Conference on Small Business in the Fall of 1979.

original_source.page_or_item: American Presidency Project web page (transcription; not an official edition); APP node 244791; common-crawl capture 2025-01-19T01:14:57Z; Sec. 1-201

operative_clauses.original_operative_text: 1-202. The Commission shall recommend issues to be considered by the Conference, including those relating to fostering of small business and the expansion of opportunities for entry into small business enterprises.

original_source.page_or_item: American Presidency Project web page (transcription; not an official edition); APP node 244791; common-crawl capture 2025-01-19T01:14:57Z; Sec. 1-202

operative_clauses.original_operative_text: 1-203. The Commission shall recommend candidates for delegates to the Conference. It shall seek the majority of representatives from those engaged in small business activity, but shall also include others interested in small business concerns, such as government regulators, financiers, public interest and academic representatives.

original_source.page_or_item: American Presidency Project web page (transcription; not an official edition); APP node 244791; common-crawl capture 2025-01-19T01:14:57Z; Sec. 1-203

operative_clauses.original_operative_text: 1-204. Prior to the White House Conference on Small Business, the Commission shall hold open regional and local meetings or conferences. These open meetings shall seek to identify the specific issues which should be addressed at the Conference and shall solicit candidates for Conference delegates.

original_source.page_or_item: American Presidency Project web page (transcription; not an official edition); APP node 244791; common-crawl capture 2025-01-19T01:14:57Z; Sec. 1-204

operative_clauses.original_operative_text: 1-205. The Commission shall make periodic recommendations to the President and the Administrator of the Small Business Administration, and shall offer such other advice at such times as the Administrator may request.

original_source.page_or_item: American Presidency Project web page (transcription; not an official edition); APP node 244791; common-crawl capture 2025-01-19T01:14:57Z; Sec. 1-205

operative_clauses.original_operative_text: 1-301. The Commission may request any Executive agency to furnish such information as may be useful in fulfilling the Commission's functions. Each such agency is authorized, to the extent permitted by law and within the limits of available funds, to furnish such information to the Commission.

original_source.page_or_item: American Presidency Project web page (transcription; not an official edition); APP node 244791; common-crawl capture 2025-01-19T01:14:57Z; Sec. 1-301

operative_clauses.original_operative_text: 1-302. Each member of the Commission who is not otherwise employed by the Federal Government shall receive no compensation from the United States by virtue of their service on the Commission, but all members may receive transportation and travel expenses, including per diem in lieu of subsistence, as authorized by law (5 U.S.C. 5702 and 5703).

original_source.page_or_item: American Presidency Project web page (transcription; not an official edition); APP node 244791; common-crawl capture 2025-01-19T01:14:57Z; Sec. 1-302

operative_clauses.original_operative_text: 1-303. All necessary administrative staff services, support, facilities, and expenses of the Commission shall, to the extent permitted by law, be furnished by the Small Business Administration.

original_source.page_or_item: American Presidency Project web page (transcription; not an official edition); APP node 244791; common-crawl capture 2025-01-19T01:14:57Z; Sec. 1-303

operative_clauses.original_operative_text: 1-401. Notwithstanding the provisions of any other Executive order, the functions of the President under the Federal Advisory Committee Act (5 U.S.C. App. I), except that of reporting annually to the Congress, which are applicable to the Commission shall be performed by the Administrator of the Small Business Administration in accordance with guidelines and procedures established by the Administrator of General Services.

original_source.page_or_item: American Presidency Project web page (transcription; not an official edition); APP node 244791; common-crawl capture 2025-01-19T01:14:57Z; Sec. 1-401

operative_clauses.original_operative_text: 1-402. The Commission shall terminate on December 31, 1979, or 60 days after the conclusion of the White House Conference on Small Business, whichever is sooner.

original_source.page_or_item: American Presidency Project web page (transcription; not an official edition); APP node 244791; common-crawl capture 2025-01-19T01:14:57Z; Sec. 1-402
